mapper.select:
del_flag = '0' AND record_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{recordCode}, '%') AND material_id = #{materialId} AND material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{materialName}, '%') AND record_type = #{recordType} AND supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{supplierName}, '%') AND recipient LIKE CONCAT('%', #{recipient}, '%') AND date_format(record_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginRecordTime},'%y%m%d') AND date_format(record_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endRecordTime},'%y%m%d') AND date_format(create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginCreateTime},'%y%m%d') AND date_format(create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endCreateTime},'%y%m%d')
ORDER BY record_time DESC
